ZU Team

Yesterday, June 10th, I called around 6:40 PM because I noticed through the app that there was an opening for a veterinary appointment at 6:45 PM. Since I live relatively close, I took the precaution of calling the store first to see if it was still possible to schedule the appointment (at the last minute). The very friendly girl who answered told me that she could schedule it for 7 PM, giving me more time (I think this was agreed upon with the veterinarian).
To my surprise, even upon arriving at the clinic, I received a call from the veterinarian saying that it was already 7 PM (which was true) and that she couldn't wait any longer because her daughter was waiting and therefore she had to leave at 7:30 PM... I even replied that I was 2 minutes from the door, to which she responded, in my opinion, quite arrogantly and unprofessionally: "If you'd be able to schedule a 30-minute appointment," even though an appointment always lasts around 45 minutes... I even replied that YES, I could. Because the reason for the consultation was very simple, an allergy in my dog ​​that she was desperate for and I already knew she would need it. I understand our individual lives, and I respect that, but I don't understand the lack of professionalism, and it's unthinkable to trust someone to touch my dog ​​after this despicable approach.

We took our rescued dog, whom we rescued 3 months ago, to Zu in Matosinhos for a consultation. We were apprehensive because it was her first appointment with us and we didn't know how she would react, but thankfully everything went very well!
The veterinarian won over our girl right away, allowing her to complete the entire check-up and vaccination without any problems! She will undoubtedly be the family veterinarian!
Excellent service from Diana Magalhaes ✨ Very good experience

I booked my cat's first veterinary appointment about two weeks in advance and received several confirmations. However, when I arrived, I was informed that the appointment had been cancelled by mistake and the time slot had already been assigned to another client.

The receptionist spoke to the veterinarian, and it was possible to hear an argument between them, which created a very uncomfortable atmosphere.

They ended up attending to my cat, but the veterinarian never actually examined her. The entire procedure (weighing and internal deworming) was done by the receptionist, despite a "clinical check-up" being charged.

I left with a feeling of disorganization and lack of professionalism in a service that should guarantee veterinary care. The only positive note was the friendliness of the shop assistant, who tried to help as much as possible.
Thank you so much for your review, Ana Almeida! It's a pleasure to know that ZU deserves your trust. Until next time! 🐾 🐶 🐱 …
We've been taking our cats to see the doctor for four years now, and she's super attentive and caring.

Dear Ana, Zuka

I want to express my deepest gratitude for all the affection, attention, and care you always give my dog ​​Zuka. Your gentle, patient, and loving way has made all the difference, both for her and for me.
Knowing that she is with someone who bathes her with such care and respect brings immense peace to my heart. Every gesture of yours demonstrates not only responsibility but also a genuine love for animals.
Thank you for treating my dog ​​Zuka with so much affection, as if she were your own. People like you make the world a better place, especially for those who entrust what is most precious to them.

With much gratitude and affection,
Mara Fernandes & Zuka 🦮❤️🐾

Lovely people
Helpful and friendly!
Booked breed specific trimming,
My dog looks at his best!

Thank you guys

Very negative experience at ZU NorteShopping

I took my two-and-a-half-month-old dachshund puppy to a veterinary appointment at ZU NorteShopping and the experience was terrible.

His nails were cut too short, causing bleeding. My dog ​​cried in fear, and the veterinarian referred to him as a "manipulator," showing zero empathy for a baby during a first consultation. The examination and cleaning of his ears were done roughly, leaving me afraid that it could cause injury.

To make matters worse, the veterinarian's coat was visibly dirty, including bloodstains, which I consider totally inappropriate in a clinical setting.

Later, I took my dog ​​to another veterinarian from the same group, at ZU Matosinhos Sul, and the difference was enormous: calm, affectionate, professional, and my puppy was calm and happy. It became clear that the problem wasn't the dog, but rather the way he was treated at this clinic. I do not recommend the veterinary service at ZU NorteShopping, especially for those who have dogs or more sensitive animals.

A store with a wide variety of products, vet services, grooming, and exclusive parking spaces in the Continente hypermarket parking lot.

I like the store; the employees are friendly. However, the veterinarian is a horrible person—arrogant, rude, shouts, and is terrible! I went once and never again, and on subsequent occasions when I went to buy flea medication, etc., and to my displeasure, having her put me on the phone, she maintained the same attitude every time. Rude, shouting, arrogant, unfriendly, horrible. It's a shame she's the only veterinarian there. I'll only remain a customer of the store; I'll never go to the vet with her again.
Good service and it's located on the mainland.

Horrible! I don't recommend it! The veterinarian was unprofessional and not very kind.
Unfortunately, I had to resort to ZU's services because the veterinarian I usually go to was unavailable. I needed to trim my cat's nails and I can't do it myself.
When I arrived, they asked if I was going to help trim the nails, to which I replied no, and also when I made the appointment they said they had people there that day to help.
The veterinarian came, said that perhaps it would be better to sedate the cat, I refused because where I go she is not sedated and I explained that if they couldn't do it, it was no problem and I would try somewhere else. They quickly told me to leave the room and that they would try.
Indeed, the cat came back with her nails trimmed, but she spent the whole trip home with her mouth open, panting as if she had been drugged, even though I asked her not to. I think it's unprofessional.
If they couldn't do it, I would have preferred that they said so.
Excellent service from the Veterinary Medicine team. Super professional, I recommend them!

I've been going to Dr. Sofia's office for a few years now and I'm very satisfied with the care she's given to both my two cats and my dog.
She's always very helpful and careful with my animals, and when she doesn't have an adequate solution in her own practice, she recommends specialist doctors to whom to refer the cases.
We will always come back!

Zu Norte Shopping has absolutely no respect for animals. The veterinarian there is irresponsible and unfit to care for pets. I went three times seeking a diagnosis for my cat, as its tail was drooping, and the veterinarian only told me that everything was normal. Curiously, when I got home, I lifted the cat's tail and it was bleeding. How can a woman who calls herself a veterinarian care for pets? Irresponsible and ill-tempered. I'm venting my frustration before she harms others.

Bad luck or not, I'm a monthly customer for my dog's food and I've only had problems to point out. There's a lot of disorganization in terms of orders. I know perfectly well that the customer isn't always right, but they could/should try to ensure the customer leaves satisfied, which isn't the case, and they don't even care or apologize for mistakes!
Very disappointed, I won't be going back there.
